rows.name: Stop the bleeding
rows.key_actions: Inventory ask; inside-tenant exports; IdP/email/expense signals; outside-in search; team defaults set; Supabase grant, RPC, definer and trigger audit per project before 30 Oct 2026; rotate bundled keys; builder domains in SSE/DLP
rows.exit_criterion: Known estate registered; no unauthenticated app with non-public data; no secret key in any bundle
rows.evidence: Registry v0; discovery report; grant audit

rows.name: Paved road
rows.key_actions: Enterprise tenant with SSO/SCIM; admin-owned connectors; registry schema live; tier policy; IdP proxy with origin validation; OIDC federation; push protection; DPA gap analysis; training tied to access
rows.exit_criterion: New apps reach data only via approved paths; every T1+ app has an owner
rows.evidence: Tenant config export; DPA gap analysis; training report

rows.name: Deterministic gates
rows.key_actions: Blocking secrets/SCA/SAST pipeline incl. build-output scan; behavioural matrix per release; managed agent settings; read-only scoped MCP; masked dev branches; isolated immutable backups with drills; retention per sink; LLM gateway retention
rows.exit_criterion: Destructive agent action or broken policy cannot reach production unnoticed
rows.evidence: Pipeline logs; matrix results; restore RTO/RPO; managed-settings status

rows.name: Run it
rows.key_actions: Weekly outside-in scan; attestation cadence by tier; quarantine on departure or missed attestation; T0 expiry; honeytokens; annual tabletop per failure mode; quarterly exception review
rows.exit_criterion: Unowned apps cease to exist by construction; exceptions trend to zero
rows.evidence: KPI dashboard; exception register; tabletop records
